decisions.decision: The board agreed to incorporate the old Primary School goal into the FY2022 goals, after going out to bid for the conceptual work.
decisions.quote: we should incorporate this goal into our 2022 goals. the board concurred

decisions.decision: The board agreed to drop FY2021 Objective 2 (re-appointment process policy).
decisions.quote: mr. jeffreys thought the process went well and did not think it needed to be modified so was in favor of dropping this goal. the board concurred

decisions.decision: Mr. Alonzo was directed to draft a short-term goal on a volunteer policy, in line with the discussion.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo will draft something in accordance with the discussion.

decisions.decision: Mr. Jeffreys was asked to send Mr. Alonzo a written note by email on salvage efforts for the old Primary School, for the goal.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo requested he send a written note to him regarding this via email so he could incorporate it in the goal.

decisions.decision: Hours for Smokestack Roasters were left for review at renewal in December; if complaints arise before then, the hours would be modified then.
decisions.quote: it was determined that if there were complaints between now and renewal time in december, the hours would be modified then.

decisions.decision: The PAYT bag price increase and senior bag relief question were deferred to a future meeting for a recommendation.
decisions.quote: this will be a recommendation made at a future meeting.

budget_items.topic: Pay As You Throw bag program cost increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Collection and disposal costs under the Solid Waste Enterprise are estimated to rise, and bag manufacturing and supply costs are also increasing, so bag costs will increase in FY2022.
budget_items.quote: estimated to increase from $318,014.00 to $419,850.00 and the costs of manufacturing and supplying the bags is also increasing

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town anticipates a Solid Waste Enterprise surplus at year end, and says none will arise in FY2022 if bag volume falls and bag prices hold.
budget_items.quote: we will have a surplus in the solid waste enterprise account of between $40,000 and $50,000 at the end of the fiscal year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free bags for seniors would be paid from Recycling Dividends Program funds, with pickup and disposal supplemented by surplus Enterprise funds; no amount was stated.
budget_items.quote: the purchase of the bags is an eligible expense using our recycling dividends program funds

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The low sub-bidder for the roofing and flashing work was Rockwell Roofing of Leominster.
budget_items.quote: the low bidder was rockwell roofing of leominster for $23,750.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total project cost is expected to exceed the capital article amount, so funds were earmarked from the Facilities budget.
budget_items.quote: in the event the total cost exceeds the capital article amount of $135,000.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road culvert construction estimate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The engineer's estimated construction cost rose to $750,000; the Town asked for a breakdown and will seek a Small Bridge Grant.
budget_items.quote: the estimated construction costs for this project are now $750,000.
